description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gemunupura, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710028
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels. It involves the declaration of title settlements for multiple land parcels, including details of ownership, extent, class of title, and encumbrances. The content falls under the Registration of Title Act and concerns land administration matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
